details: No a static rule matches were produced for this package version, and behavioral tracing output was malformed and could not be parsed into concrete findings. There is no evidence in the current record of installer-side attack behavior (no traced exfiltration endpoint, no install-time fetch-and-execute, no credential access, no silent-relay, no backdoor), and also no positive confirmation that the package is benign. The package name resembles the popular `chai` assertion library, which is a common typosquat shape, but name resemblance alone is not a threat and this record contains no traced code behavior to classify.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
